body.objective: Independently replay the complete or maximal parity-even five-form-factor result before any coefficient-bearing theorem is frozen.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal five-form-factor assembly and all source hashes without running its producer.  Reconstruct the carrier projection from the original physical/ghost determinant factors by a method-distinct heat-kernel, covariant-perturbation or differential-equation route; verify every labelled-box symmetry, functional relation, scale derivative, contact endpoint and local-normalization separation; and replay the round-S4, anisotropic S2xS2, equal-box and flat-TT holdouts.  If the producer terminates in nondefinition, independently prove that two admissible completions of the named missing datum give different unresolved functions while preserving all imported finite data.  Export a freeze receipt or the smallest contradiction.
body.forbid: no producer serialization called verification; no special-background agreement treated as generic completeness; no omitted zero-mode, contact or scheme direction; no parity-odd, QME, Lorentzian or particle promotion
activates: or a repaired coefficient lane with an exact contradiction
body.resource_hint: QUANTUM INDEPENDENT RAIL.  Verify the generic functions, or prove the terminal nondefinition by constructing two compatible completions.
notes: The independent rail must test generic labelled-box data, not only the already certified special backgrounds.
